paper_title: The Unseen Targets of Hate -- A Systematic Review of Hateful   Communication Datasets
caption: Conceptualized and operationalized targets by year along with the distribution of datasets. Targeted refers to datasets that have explicitly mentioned at least one target in their construct definition (i.e., in the conceptualization phase) and/or publications in which the authors define concrete measures to ensure and validate the presence of at least one target group in the data (i.e., in the operationalization phase). Untargeted refers to all other datasets that do not meet these two criteria. Note that the data for 2022 is only partially available (as described in our Methods and Data Section).

annotations.annotation: The bar chart illustrates the number of datasets collected over a series of years, categorized into "Targeted" and "Untargeted" types. The horizontal axis represents the years, ranging from 2012 to 2022, with a linear scale and individual years labeled consecutively. The vertical axis indicates the "Number of datasets", also using a linear scale, with values ranging from 0 to 160 at intervals of 20. Each bar is divided into two stacked segments: blue representing "Untargeted" and orange representing "Targeted". In 2012 to 2015, the overall height of the bars is minimal, with both types present but at lower values. Starting from 2016, the height of the bars begins to increase, with the "Targeted" segment growing larger in subsequent years. For 2016, the total number of datasets is 15. For 2017, the number of datasets increased to 25, followed by 45 in 2018, 65 in 2019, 130 in 2020, and 160 in 2021. In 2022, both segments are present but shorter than in 2021.
